response.reason: The cited clause, Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1), establishes the requirement for a quantitative ingredient declaration (QUID) when an ingredient appears in the name of the food, is emphasised on the label, or is essential to characterise the food. The verdict turns on whether 'Wholemeal WHEAT flour' meets these criteria and whether its percentage is declared. The clause directly sets out these requirements, so it supports the verdict.
